title: 1Nov-DiwaliParty Integration&Inclusion Prog of SEC
summary: A Diwali Party was organised on 1 Nov for the beneficiaries of the Integration and Inclusion Programme of SEC at the Radio Club, Colaba.
description:
A Diwali Party was organised on 1 Nov for the beneficiaries of the Integration and Inclusion Programme of SEC at the Radio Club, Colaba. The celebration brought together 115 participants for an afternoon of festivities, joy and inclusion.

The highlight was the Fashion show which was choreographed by Chirag Agarwal.
The project was supported through generous contributions from:

Homi Rustom Bhot – ₹25,000
Rtn. Prakash Chawla – ₹50,000
Araj Let’s Care Foundation – ₹25,000
Rotary Club of Bombay Pier Charities Trust – ₹10,000

The following special gifts were distributed:

• Rtn. PP Paresh Shah donated 20 thali sets for the participants of the fashion show.
• Rtn. PP Shabir Gabajiwalla donated 75 game sets as return gifts for 75 persons with disabilities
The event was attended by: Pres Rtn. Amit Gupta, Rtn. Manju Uttamchandani, Rtn. Dr. Sangeeta Agrawal and 8 Rotaractors of SIES
Total participants: 75 beneficiaries and 23 parents & attendants.
Project cost Rs 1.10 lakhs
